At Lineage, you’ll have the opportunity to make a global impact by transforming the food supply chain. You’ll work on cutting-edge technology, collaborate with industry leaders, and help shape the future of logistics and warehousing. Why Lineage? DIVISION - AGENCY OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT/SECTION - INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY About The Agency Operations Division The Agency Operations division is the administrative backbone to the PUCT and has several departments within the division that play an integral role to the everyday operations of the agency. Agency Counsel Agency Counsel provides legal advice and guidance to the commissioners, executive management, and other divisions relating to legal matters affecting the operation of the agency in order to minimize risk, facilitate decision-making, and ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements and PUCT policies and rules. The division processes the agency's Public Information Act requests, advises on contracting and procurement processes, assists with the development of internal policies, conducts internal investigations and advises executive management, serves as the agency's ethics advisor, provides training to agency employees, and provides advice on special projects as assigned. Central Records Central Records receives and processes filing submissions for cases before the Commission. Staff members assist customers, utility representatives, the public, and staff with filing documents in docketed cases and ongoing agency projects. Filed documents include pleadings, testimony, briefs, affidavits, requests for information, rulemakings, registrations, tariffs, certificates of convenience and necessity, sale, transfer, and mergers, interconnection agreements, ADADs, and annual reports. Staff also reviews filings and evaluates documents for compliance with federal and state privacy laws prior to processing. Central Records processes confidential materials, workshop and open meeting transcripts, and agency publications and works with the Financial Resources Division on billing and payments for registrations, copies, and publications. Library The PUCT Library offers a dynamic research collection of books, periodicals, technical standards, legislative and government documents, newspapers, and online databases pertaining to law, energy regulation, electricity, water, telecommunications, engineering, and utility finance. Position Summary This role is a highly technical Business Analyst to serve as a Solution Subject Matter Expert (SME) within a complex, enterprise lottery systems environment. Support full lifecycle activities including design validation, UAT preparation, production readiness, and post-launch support. Apply structured methodology and change management best practices to ensure governance alignment and documentation quality. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. Years Of Related Experience 3+ years of Business Analysis experience in complex system environments Position Required /Qualifications Experience participating in full life cycle (FLC) implementations. Working knowledge of: System architecture Integration sequencing Configuration & customization Production cutover processes Experience developing use cases and conducting gap analysis. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly at all organizational levels. Strong documentation and analytical skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio). Lottery industry experience preferred. Experience using JIRA or similar backlog management tools. Strong technical aptitude and systems thinking, with demonstrated experience authoring detailed functional and system requirements in complex environments. Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, multi-project environments while maintaining quality and attention to technical detail. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical teams and drive alignment. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including experience translating business needs into technically sound requirements and identifying integration impacts. Customer-focused professional written and verbal communication skills, capable of clearly explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Job_Title: Business Analyst - eSC or eDV Clearance Required
JD_text:
At IBM Consulting UK FutureNow, you’ll build a career at the forefront of hybrid cloud and AI, working with leading clients across the public and private sectors.

You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth.

We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique.

We Offer

Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme
More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice.

Your Role And Responsibilities

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst to join our delivery team and help shape high quality digital and technology solutions. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, testers, and vendors to gather and document requirements, analyse problems, and ensure that technical solutions meet business needs.

You will translate complex business objectives into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. You will support all stages of the SDLC, helping teams understand dependencies, evaluate impacts, and deliver high quality outcomes. Your ability to communicate clearly, analyse issues, and facilitate workshops will be essential as you help shape solution design and guide delivery teams.

As a Technical BA, you will also bring a practical understanding of how systems integrate, how APIs and data flows behave, and how non functional requirements influence technology decisions. Depending on your experience, you may lead requirement workstreams, mentor other analysts, or contribute to account level planning and stakeholder management.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, engaging with both business and technical teams, and helping deliver solutions that add real value, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Gather and document business and functional requirements. 
Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and use cases. 
Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and solution assessments. 
Work with developers, testers, architects, and vendors to clarify requirements. 
Support Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning and backlog refinement. 
Assist with testing activities by validating requirements and reviewing results. 
Depending on experience, help guide workshops, mentor team members, or support stakeholder engagement.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Strong requirement gathering and documentation skills 
Functional specification writing (user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases) 
Impact analysis and gap analysis 
SDLC knowledge (Agile, iterative, and traditional models) 
Process mapping (BPMN or equivalent) 
Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and system interactions 
Ability to read/interpret technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and data flow diagrams 
Understanding of non-functional requirement categories 
Strong communication and stakeholder management 
Workshop facilitation 
Problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and structured reasoning 
Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, testers, architects, and vendors

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personal Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NVS) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV).

Job Description
As a Business Analyst at MACH, you will act as the critical bridge between our financial services clients and our software development teams. You will be responsible for eliciting, analysing, and translating complex business requirements, particularly across digital assets, tokenisation, and market infrastructure, into clear, actionable user stories and functional specifications that drive delivery.
This role suits a commercially minded analyst who is equally comfortable in client workshops and sprint planning sessions, someone who understands how capital markets and digital asset ecosystems operate, and who can engage credibly with both business stakeholders and engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered that genuinely meet client needs.
Responsibilities
Job requirements
Lead requirements-gathering sessions with clients, facilitating workshops to elicit, challenge, and validate business needs across digital asset and financial services use cases.
Translate business requirements into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications suitable for Agile development teams.
Document current-state business processes, workflows, and use cases, verifying accuracy with clients and internal teams before baseline sign-off.
Identify process improvement opportunities and work with clients and internal stakeholders to design future-state operating models, particularly in the context of digital asset adoption and tokenised workflows.
Present and communicate specifications clearly to software development teams, ensuring requirements are understood, estimated, and prioritised appropriately within the product backlog.
Act as the client-side voice throughout the development lifecycle, providing ongoing clarification, managing scope, and ensuring delivered functionality remains aligned with original business intent.
Support and oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), verifying that software functionality meets agreed requirements and specifications before client sign-off.
Support clients in articulating and documenting their own business requirements where needed, acting as a trusted advisor rather than simply an order-taker.
Deliver training, presentations, and demonstrations of MACH’s software to clients and internal staff, ensuring adoption and understanding of new functionality.
Identify, escalate, and help resolve issues or blockers experienced by clients or internal team members, maintaining clear communication throughout.
Requirements
Fin-Tech, consulting or client-facing experience within financial services, ideally across capital markets, post-trade, or digital assets.
Solid understanding of market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, or tokenisation workflows.
Demonstrable experience writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications for software development teams.
Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and working within cross-functional delivery teams.
Sufficient technical literacy to engage meaningfully with software developers, understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data flows, without needing to write code.
Excellent client relationship skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing expectations across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and operational processes and translate them into clear requirements.
Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, and process modelling or diagramming software (e.g. Visio, Lucidchart).
Capable of producing clear, concise, and well-structured documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), process maps, and test scripts.

Healthcare technology experience, including familiarity with clinical terminology and workflows

Business Analyst
Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. The company, which is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia has company-owned leisure and corporate travel business in 23 countries, spanning Australia, New Zealand, the Americas, Europe, the United Kingdom, South Africa, the United Arab Emirates and Asia. FCTG also operates a global corporate travel management network, which extends to more than 90 countries through company-owned businesses and independent licensees. The company opened its first leisure travel shop in Sydney, Australia in 1982 and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 1995. Our purpose is to “open up the world for those who want to see”. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something really amazing – travel!
To learn more about Flight Centre Travel Group please click HERE
About The Opportunity
Join Flight Centre Travel Group’s Digital Workplace Team and play a key role in shaping the tools and platforms that support our global Onboarding and Customer Success teams. This is an exciting opportunity for an analytical and detail-oriented Business Analyst who enjoys solving business problems, uncovering insights, and translating stakeholder needs into meaningful outcomes. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, QA resources, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions deliver measurable business value. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where communication, critical thinking, and continuous improvement are valued, we’d love to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business context through stakeholder engagement, process documentation, support records, operational evidence, and business communications.
Complete Project Analysis for new products and Change Request Analysis for enhancements to existing platforms.
Document current-state processes, business impacts, risks, dependencies, and feasibility considerations.
Structure work into business-outcome-focused Epics and produce comprehensive Business Analysis documentation.
Define and document business requirements, expected outcomes, acceptance criteria, and key success measures.
Write detailed acceptance criteria using Given/When/Then methodology.
Provide business-impact data, supporting evidence, and scope recommendations to assist prioritization decisions.
Leverage approved AI tools to improve analysis quality, identify gaps, validate requirements, and challenge assumptions while maintaining accountability for final outputs.
Facilitate requirements workshops, walkthroughs, and stakeholder discussions.
Ensure approved business decisions and requirements are accurately documented before design commences.
Support Design, Development, QA, and UAT activities by providing timely business clarification and requirement updates.
Participate in design reviews to confirm alignment between solutions and approved business outcomes.
Lead UAT planning, execution, defect management, retesting activities, and final business sign-off.
Maintain complete and traceable requirements, decisions, and documentation within Notion.
Maintain process maps and delivery flows using approved modeling tools.
Review support cases, usage trends, recurring issues, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
Apply sound judgement when handling customer, business, operational, and system information.
Communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, global regions, and multiple time zones.
Other duties and tasks as assigned
Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive
Experience & Qualifications
Previous experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within enterprise SaaS, CRM, low-code, automation, or digital workplace environments.
Demonstrated experience producing structured business analysis from problem definition through implementation and UAT.
Strong experience writing Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
Experience maintaining traceability between business requirements, design decisions, testing, and sign-off activities.
Proven ability to synthesize complex, incomplete, or conflicting information into clear business requirements.
Strong understanding of business analysis methodologies and stakeholder management practices.
Experience collaborating with developers, technical leads, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Experience using AI tools to support requirements analysis, validation, or quality review.
Experience using Notion or similar requirements and documentation platforms.
Exposure to Nintex K2, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, or comparable workflow and automation platforms.
Knowledge of Dataverse, Azure, integrations, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or similar technologies is advantageous.
Experience with Lucidchart or comparable process-modeling tools is preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
CBAP, PMI-PBA, or related Business Analysis certification is advantageous.
Ability to collaborate across global time zones, including occasional early morning or evening meetings.

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

About Orde Financial
ORDE is a rapidly growing non-bank mortgage lending business committed to elevating Australian specialist lending standards. We provide comprehensive product solutions and deliver leading service levels, leveraging digital capabilities and deep industry experience.

Our purpose “Built for Brokers” is clear and simple and define our entire strategy (delivering better experiences, more value and opportunity, anticipating more needs and communicating more solutions, for brokers and their customers).
About The Role
We’re seeking a Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical delivery within our product-led operating model. Working closely with Product Owners, you will drive continuous discovery, manage requirements, and translate complex lending needs into actionable user stories. You will be instrumental in analysing and optimising end-to-end business processes to enhance our core platforms and digital experiences, working alongside the product team, peer business analysts and the wider Digital team.
Your Key Responsibilities Will Include
Requirements elicitation & analysis: Facilitate discovery workshops, interviews and observations with business stakeholders to gather, structure and critically evaluate functional and non-functional requirements.
Product delivery & backlog management: Partner with Product Owners to write detailed user stories, define robust acceptance criteria, and ensure the development team has a well-groomed, execution-ready backlog.
Process modelling & optimisation: Map current-state (AS-IS) and future-state (TO-BE) end-to-end lending workflows – from broker submission through credit assessment to settlement – identifying opportunities for efficiency, automation and continuous improvement.
Technical translation & documentation: Act as the bridge between business subject matter experts and engineering teams, producing high-quality functional specifications, data mapping, business rules logic and integration documentation.
Stakeholder management & alignment: Build strong relationships across credit, operations, risk and technology teams. Manage scope expectations, resolve conflicting requirements and ensure strategic alignment on delivered solutions.
Solution evaluation & UAT: Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing with business SMEs, validating that delivered features meet the original business intent, usability standards and the compliance requirements expected in the lending sector.
Value and benefits tracking: Build commercial cases for investment and track the benefits of delivered solutions to evaluate success and inform future enhancements.
Why would we choose you?
Lending domain expertise: 3+ years as a Business Analyst in Australian financial services, ideally within a non-bank lender, mortgage manager or aggregator.
Subject matter knowledge: Deep understanding of the mortgage lifecycle, including broker distribution channels, credit assessment models and loan origination systems.
Core BA toolkit: Proficiency in industry-standard techniques (BPMN process modelling, use case development, data flow diagrams) and tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Lucidchart/Visio and Excel.
Agile delivery: Strong background in Agile environments and a product-centric operating model, with a track record of helping product teams translate strategy into delivery.
Analytical & technical acumen: Able to navigate ambiguous requirements, simplify complex financial processes and understand system data structures. Familiarity with APIs and data querying is highly regarded.
Communication & facilitation: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor technical concepts for non-technical audiences and vice versa.
Critical thinking & problem solving: Proactive in identifying roadblocks and the root causes of operational pain points, and in evaluating alternative solutions.
Detail orientation: Precision in documenting compliance-heavy lending rules, decisioning logic and edge cases for development teams.
Customer focus: Passionate about creating great experiences for our customers, brokers and staff.
Adaptability: Organised and comfortable navigating a complex, fast-paced environment with multiple competing priorities.
Why would you choose us?
We are a fast-growing successful company.
We think it’s exciting to be part of a team which is building something which will make a difference.
We are focused, disruptive, think outside of the box and will encourage you to try new things.
We really care about our people and want them to have the best experience of their career.
We guarantee fun, a challenge, learning and growth!
We embrace being challenged through diversity of thoughts.
We have a highly collaborative culture and provide an inclusive, enjoyable office experience for all staff.
We are Melbourne based and think being in the office all together is important and we think working from home is too: three days in the office (Mon-Tues-Thurs), two days at home.
We remunerate well and reward high performance.
Join Us
We are dedicated to investing in our team, offering competitive remuneration benefits, and fostering a high-quality employment culture that values your ability to deliver and contribute.
Our team members are driven by the pursuit of a challenging and successful career in an outstanding business with a passionate, high-performance team culture.

Facilitate meetings and workshops, ensuring requirements, decisions and actions are clearly captured.
Communicate business, process and data requirements clearly and appropriately for different audiences.
